prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a rear-end collision in Katy, Texas, and has back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1164; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thanks for taking the time to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather not put my name on it yet. Can we just use the claim number?
Q: That works for the file. Can you tell me where you were when the collision happened?
A: I was stopped at a light on a main road in Katy, Texas, heading toward the freeway. Traffic had slowed down ahead of me.
Q: What happened next?
A: The car behind me didn't stop in time. I felt a hard jolt from behind, and my head snapped back and then forward. The seatbelt grabbed me pretty hard.
Q: Did you get out of your vehicle right away?
A: I sat there for a minute. My neck and lower back were already tightening up. I got out after the other driver came over to check on me.
Q: Did you seek any medical attention?
A: Yes, I went to an urgent care clinic that afternoon. They looked at my back and said it was a strain, probably soft tissue. They gave me muscle relaxers and told me to rest and avoid heavy lifting.
Q: Are you still experiencing pain?
A: Yes. Sitting for long periods is the worst. Bending over to pick things up hurts, and I've had trouble sleeping on my side. I've been doing gentle stretches the clinic recommended.
Q: Have you missed any work because of the injury?
A: I've been able to work from home for the past few days, but I had to cut back on the driving part of my job, and that's cost me some hours.
Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add about the accident?
A: Only that I was following the traffic rules and had not been distracted. I just want my back to get better and this to be handled fairly.
Q: Thank you. That concludes the statement.
A: Thanks. I appreciate your patience.
